eligibility.quote: https://github.com/ros2/launch/pull/567 seems to have introduced the behavior change in Foxy.  The issue exists in Galactic and Rolling as well.

failed_conditions.quote: `set_env` behaviour seems to have changed. It now "leaks" - `set_env` now affects places that are sequentially before the tag, including overriding those that are set deeper. Now one can only override the last `set_env` with an `env` in `node`/`executable`.

loudness.quote:
For included demo, actual result:
```
[env_bug_node-1] my_env_var = '4'
```

resolution.quote: The change for Foxy has been merged and will be in the upcoming patch release. Here's a release note for the behavior change: https://github.com/ros2/ros2_documentation/pull/2904

notes: 独立核验：(1) issue #1244 正文完整（复现包 env_bug 源码/两个 XML launch 文件/CMakeLists/运行命令与工件 C3-034.txt 一致；expected "my_env_var = '2'"，actual "'4'"；"Foxy, might be release 8" vs "Foxy, any release before current"）。(2) 附件 ros-foxy-package-versions.txt 确认 "ros-foxy-launch/focal,focal,now 0.10.8-2focal.20220112.192334 amd64"。(3) 维护者 jacobperron 两条关键评论逐字确认（PR #567 引入行为变化；"scoping environment variables to group actions has never formally been supported. It just happened to work in earlier versions of Foxy (and only with frontend launch files) because of a bug that was fixed in https://github.com/ros2/launch/pull/468.  You can confirm by installing Foxy patch 6; or specifically [launch 0.10.7]"）。(4) PR #630 "[foxy] Support scoping environment variables (#601)" 合并入 foxy 分支 2022-07-25（merge aabc2412）。(5) 文档 PR #2330 diff 确认 "Changes to environment variables using the ``set_env`` action are no longer scoped to parent ``group`` actions, and instead apply globally." 与 "We consider this change a regression"。(6) 分类 other 成立：set_env 名称与属性未变，变的是相对 group 的作用域语义，无更专类可用； implicated elements（set_env+group）合理。reporter 生产 launch 文件中 required/doc 属性移除属另一消费单元（其生产包），按规则记 notes 不记条件，处理正确。未发现遗漏条件。
